name: PM SVANidhi
benefit: Collateral-free working capital loans of ₹15,000, ₹25,000 and ₹50,000 in progressive tranches, along with other digital and credit-related benefits.
documents: Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation, where applicable

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: Skill training, toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000 and collateral-free enterprise development credit support up to ₹3 lakh for eligible traditional artisans.

name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments for eligible landholding farmer families.
documents: Other documents as required by the State/UT

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
benefit: Supports eligible fishers and fish workers through fisheries-sector welfare measures, including group accidental insurance and livelihood support under applicable components.
documents: Fisher/Fisheries-related Registration or ID, where applicable

name: NAMASTE
benefit: Promotes safety and dignity of sanitation workers through occupational safety, access to entitlements and livelihood support. Waste pickers are also covered under the scheme.
